name: Injinji
description: Performance toesock brand (founded 1999) whose patented five-toe socks are a cult staple with runners, hikers and ultrarunners. Its own affiliate page publishes an 8% commission, a 30-day cookie and a dedicated in-house affiliate manager, with the program hosted on AvantLink and applications screened by the brand.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page: 'When customers follow an Affiliate's unique URL to make an Injinji.com purchase, an 8% commission is earned', with a 30-day cookie duration, banners/text links/product feed and a dedicated in-house affiliate manager.

The same page invites 'a website or blog owner in the active or outdoor industry' to apply, states the program 'is hosted by AvantLink', and notes every applicant goes through a screening process. No cap statement appears on the page, so commission_cap stays unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Toesocks are a distinctive, demonstrable product for running, trail and foot-health content - blister-prevention and gear-test videos write themselves.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page recruits active/outdoor website and blog owners and supplies banners, text links and a product feed; it is publisher-facing rather than a social-first creator portal, so the score is mid-range.
reasons.compensation: 8% per sale with a 30-day cookie, published on the brand's own page; no cap statement was found, so the cap is honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated in-house affiliate manager is promised on the page, but no direct email is published there.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application from the brand's own page into AvantLink, free to join, with a screening step.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 1999 with a patented product and the full inventory on its own storefront - an established niche brand.

name: Crowned Athletics
description: Women's activewear brand with a princess-inspired design identity and a loyal Instagram community. Its own 'Crowned Crew' affiliate program pays 10% commission on new purchases made with an affiliate's unique code, runs through GoAffPro, and pays via PayPal - but it is selective: applicants must be current customers with a public Instagram page.

evidence.summary: The brand's own help-centre program page: 'Affiliates earn 10% commission on any new purchases made using their unique code', repeated in the payout terms - 'Payouts are eligible 45 days after the sale date and are issued between the 1st and 5th of each month', paid through PayPal.

The same page sets the entry bar: applicants must be current customers (a purchase within the past 12 months) with a public Instagram page, must follow @CrownedAthletics, and apply via the linked GoAffPro portal (crowned-athletics.goaffpro.com). No cap statement appears, so commission_cap stays unknown.

opportunity.title: Crowned Athletics Crowned Crew Affiliate Program (GoAffPro)

reasons.niche_fit: Women's activewear with a strong visual identity is prime fitness-fashion UGC - try-ons, gym outfits and themed collections.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is built around Instagram creators: a public Instagram page is mandatory, codes are formatted from the affiliate's handle, and the brand claims usage rights over tagged photos for its own channels - clear, documented UGC mechanics.
reasons.compensation: 10% on new purchases via code, published in the brand's own terms with a defined payout schedule; no cap statement was found, so the cap is honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the GoAffPro portal linked from the brand's own page; no direct partnerships email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Selective rather than open: only current customers with a public Instagram page are considered, which limits availability.
reasons.credibility: A real, operating DTC brand with detailed published terms, but small and niche compared with national activewear labels.
